paper.title_en: Quantum Theory Angular Momentum; Electronic version 2026
paper.abstract_en: This is an electronic version of the open source book "Quantum Theory of Angular Momentum" by D. A. Varshalovich, A. N. Moskalev, V. K. Khersonskii, original copyright {̧o̧p̧y̧ŗi̧ģḩţ}̧ 1988 by World Scientific Publishing Co. Pte. Ltd, with the CC-BY 4.0 open source ebook funded by SCOAP. We have made appropriate modifications for the modern age--such as python-based symbolic manipulators to replace algebraic and numeric the tables. The new version contains a number of small modification, even though it is close to the original, with additional indices, hyperlinking, redrawing of figures. There has been a substantial check of the results presented, supported by the use of AI, even though all mistakes are the author's responsibility. All material is available from the book's github site (https://github.com/nwalet/Varshalovich/), where new updated versions will also be presented.
